For units, they receive 1,000 damage instead. |ability1_cooldown = 10 }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Now they have pyromancers?!|audio = Null&VoidN1Wave17-1.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 17 ([[Outpost 16]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Pyromancer''', internally referred to as the '''Corrupted Pyromancer''', was a support enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had a decent amount of health and an above average speed. It also had the [[Freeze Immunity|Freeze]], [[Stun Immunity|Stun]] and [[Burn Immunity|Burn]] immunities, making it harder to apply effects to it. The '''Null Pyromancer''' has one ability, where it will fire out corrupted flames from its mouth. This will set any tower hit on fire, applying a 30% [[Firerate Debuff]] that increased firerate by around 42.85% and a [[Scared Debuff]] which decreased tower range by 15%. Both effects lasted 6 seconds. If it hits a unit, it will deal 1,000 damage to them with its breath. It can be spawned by the [[Null Commander]], which boosts its [[Defense]] to 50%. ==Logbook Description== "''As the Null Pyro emerged from the [[Nil Zone]]'s depths, purple sludge dripped from its gaping mouth. [[Pyromancer|Pyro]] watched with a mixture of fascination and disgust, flames burning in his eyes as a creepy grin crossed his face. The creature rose to its feet, and as it stood, [[Pyromancer|Pyro]]'s flamethrower ignited.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Pyromancer''' is a corrupted version of the [[Pyromancer]]. It has purple skin. It wears a purple suit with black shoes, knee-pads, shoulder-pads, vest and a gas mask. It also has a few gas tanks on its back. In its gas mask, it has a small gap where its mouth would be. This allows it to spit out corrupted flames which debuff towers. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *Towers with decent DPS, like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Accelerator]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Ranger]] or [[Minigunner]] are recommended here. *Because of its immunities, various debuffs do not work on it. **It cannot be knocked back by towers and stuns will only slow it down as it has the [[Stun Immunity]]. **It cannot be frozen, chilled or have its [[Defense]] reduced through chillness as it has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. **It cannot be damaged by burn or have its [[Defense]] reduced by it as it has the [[Burn Immunity]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} NullPyromancerWalkAnimation.gif|Walking animation (18 October 2025 – Present) NullPyromancerBreathAnimation.gif|''Foul Breath'' animation (18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullPyro.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version(18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} NullPyromancerPI.png|'''Null Pyromancer''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Null & Void Event Night 1 All Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Null Pyromancer''' in the [[Outpost 16]] cutscenes. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Null Pyromancer''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. NullPyromancerIconIG.png|'''Null Pyromancer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Null Pyromancer''' was unusual as it was one of the few enemies to actually buff towers rather than debuff them. **For whatever reason, its range reduction was actually a range increase, making it increase range of towers by 15%, though this got fixed in [[v1.78.0]]. *The '''Null Pyromancer''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Null Pyromancer''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Null Pyromancer''' has a broken icon. **{{Bug}} '''Null Pyromancer''' is positioned sideways in the [[Index]]. **{{Bug}} ''Foul Breath's'' [[Scared Debuff]] increases tower range instead of decreasing it. *'''19 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0|v1.77.3a]] **[[Logbooks|Logbook]] description added. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]] **Now appears in [[Banlands]]. **''Foul Breath'' damage increased from 500 to 1,000. **{{Bugfix}} ''Foul Breath'' now decreases tower range. **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Pyromancer''' is now properly positioned in the [[Index]]. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **Now appears in [[Blind Faith]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Pyromancer''' now uses its correct icon. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Null Pyromancer''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{Outpost16|[[Null Warden]]|Wave 15|Null Pyromancer|Wave 17|[[Null Commander]]|Wave 20}} {{Banlands|[[Null Warden]]|Wave 18|Null Pyromancer|Wave 20|[[Null Guardian]]|Wave 25}} {{BlindFaith|[[Null Engineer]]|Wave 10|Null Pyromancer|Wave 11|[[Null Warden]]|Wave 13}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
